lesson_title: Gender, Stereotypes and the Mulvey Male Gaze

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to Laura Mulvey, gender stereotypes and the male gaze.

items.title: Laura Mulvey's Male Gaze / Feminist Theory — Mrs Fisher
items.description: Clear GCSE-level guide to Mulvey's theory with examples — essential viewing before your exam.

items.title: The Danger of a Single Story — Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie (TED)
items.description: Adichie's iconic TED Talk on how stereotypes flatten complex identities — a powerful parallel to Mulvey's critique of how women are framed.

items.title: Miss Representation (2011)
items.description: Exposes how American media sells girls the idea that their value lies in youth and beauty — directly relevant to Mulvey and gender stereotyping.

items.title: Gone Girl (2014)
items.description: Fincher's psychological thriller interrogates how media constructs and consumes female identity — great for unpacking the male gaze.
